verses.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.2: You commanded the children of Israel and said to them, “You are coming to the land of Canaan. This is the land that will be given to you as a inheritance. It is the land of Canaan, with its hills.”
verses.3: And there will be a barren land from the shore of the Red Sea, by the hand of Adam. And there will also be a barren land from the side of the salty sea, in front of you.
verses.4: And the border will be marked from north to south, passing through Akravim. Its exits will be from north to the holy place of Barne’a. Then it will go through Adar’s courtyard, and then it will pass through Azmonah.
verses.5: And the border would extend from its own origins, from the land of Egypt. And its outlets would be the Yamama.
verses.6: And there will be a sea around you, and that sea will be the great sea for you. And this sea will also be your sea boundary.
verses.7: And it shall be a boundary for you from the great sea. It will serve as a mountain range for you.
verses.8: From the top of the mountain, one could see the heat and the openings in the border.
verses.9: And the border would extend from Zefrona. Its exits would be like the gates of Eden. This will be your southern border.
verses.10: And they advised you to go ahead to the border, from the palace of Eion Shafama.
verses.11: And the border descended from the heights of Harbelah in advance towards Ai. And the border also descended and covered over the coast of Kinneret.
verses.12: And the border of the land will descend to the Yardenah. Its exits will be the Sea of Salt. This will be your land, around which you can settle down.
verses.13: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, “This is the land that you shall inherit. It is divided into nine parts, with half of each part being given to each tribe.”
verses.14: For they took the land of the sons of Reuben for their inheritance, and the land of the sons of Gad for their inheritance. And half of the land of Manasseh was taken as their inheritance.
verses.15: The two branches and half of the branch were taken as their inheritance from beyond, to Yarden. Yeraho was the first to receive it from Zerah.
verses.16: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.17: These are the names of the men who will inherit the land for you: Elazar the priest and Jehoshua son of Nun.
verses.18: And one man will rule over the land, from the top down. You will take possession of that land as your inheritance.
verses.19: And these are the names of the people of Judah: Chelub, son of Yefunah.
verses.20: And from the descendants of Shimeon, Shemuel son of Jemimah.
verses.21: To Matti Ben Niman Elidad, son of Kisloon.
verses.22: And from the sons of Dan, Naashi’i Bukki, son of Yagli.
verses.23: Livney Yosef, to the sons of Menachem. Nasihel ben Efod.
verses.24: And among the sons of Ephraim, Reuben was the leader. His name was Kemuel.
verses.25: And from the descendants of Zebulun, Elizaphan son of Pardenach became king.
verses.26: And from the descendants of Issachar, Nahshon son of Pemhelah became king.
verses.27: And from the sons of Asher, reigned Ahijud, son of Shlomo.
verses.28: And from the sons of Naphtali, Reuben was born, named Pedahel, son of Judah.
verses.29: These are those whom Yahweh commanded to scatter the children of Israel across the land of Canaan.
